ar002 -- written by Haruhiko Okumura and released to the public domain.

Source: support/ayfxedit-improved/src/lh5/ in the ayfxedit-improved
reference clone (https://github.com/Threetwosevensixseven/ayfxedit-improved),
which itself vendors ar002's LZSS+Huffman ("-lh5-") compressor/decompressor
for its VTX importer. Only the decode side is used by ayfxedit-wx (VTX
import). encode.c was dropped entirely (nothing here calls encode(), and
it isn't valid C++ as-is — it uses `new` as a variable name, among other
C-only constructs). maketree.cpp is still included even though nothing
calls make_tree() directly either: huf.cpp's (unused) encode-side
functions reference it, and dropping maketree.cpp would leave an
unresolved symbol at link time.

See io.cpp and ar.h for the two small, documented modifications made for
this port (both noted inline as "MODIFIED from upstream").
